Contract Generator.contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::cancelReservation(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		reservedCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		self.uid.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		self.barcode.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		User.allInstance()->includes(uid) and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(barcode) and
		ob.ReservedCopy.oclIsUndefined()
	postcondition:
		let reservedCopy: BookCopy in
		reservedCopy.oclIsNew() and
		Reserve.allInstance()->includes(reservedCopy) and
		reservedCopy.Status = 'AVAILABLE' and
		result = true
}
